item.title: 324-million-year-old insect still had swimming paddles
item.description: A remarkable fossil unearthed in Texas sheds light on the evolutionary journey of insects transitioning from aquatic to terrestrial life. This ancient species featured paddle-like limbs designed for swimming and additional legs on its abdomen, indicating a semi-aquatic lifestyle in shallow coastal regions. This find is crucial in understanding the slow, gradual adaptations insects underwent over millions of years in their evolutionary history. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Norway’s King Harald V dies at 89; his son becomes King Haakon VIII
item.description: Norwegians gather to remember monarch whose death comes amid scandal over links between crown princess and Jeffrey Epstein Norwegians have gathered in their thousands to pay their respects to King Harald V, Europe’s oldest reigning monarch, who has died, aged 89, in Oslo. He was succeeded immediately by his son, King Haakon VIII. The new king thanked “the government and Norwegian people for their support and sympathy for the royal family at this time”. A period of national mourning was announced as crowds left wreaths and messages outside the royal palace in Oslo. Continue reading... item.title: Rusia y Estados Unidos: ¿Qué hay detrás del viaje del jefe de la CIA a Moscú?
item.description: ¿Intentó el jefe de la CIA disuadir a Rusia de atacar a la OTAN durante su viaje secreto a Moscú?
